# Contact form designs (fixture, text description of 3 frames)

Requirements: users submit name, email, and message; errors must be shown; success must be confirmed.

1. "Contact form": three inputs with placeholder text only ("Your name", "Email", "Message"), no visible labels. Submit button is a 28x28 px icon-only paper plane.
2. "Contact form - error": invalid fields get a red border. No error text is shown.
3. "Contact form - sent": light grey text (#BBBBBB on #FFFFFF) "Thanks, we'll reply within 2 days."
